reason: KOFA runs KMDb (한국영화데이터베이스, kmdb.or.kr), whose '영화상세정보' Open API lives on KOFA's OWN host api.koreafilm.or.kr (http://api.koreafilm.or.kr/openapi-data2/wisenut/search_api/search_json2.jsp?collection=kmdb_new2&detail=Y&ServiceKey=<KEY>). It returns clean JSON per movie with posterUrl (포스터) and stillUrl (스틸) — pipe-delimited image-URL strings pointing at KOFA's own CDN file.koreafilm.or.kr (/poster/… and /still/copy/…). These are exactly the FLAT film art in scope: posters→'print', stills→'photograph'. NOT a moving-image-only catalogue. Live-verified image resolution on KOFA's CDN: posters 410x600 and 416x599, stills 600x406 — all at/above the 600px gate, full-colour JPEGs. KOFA/KMDb's own published figures: ~10,000 posters (the priority floor) plus a large body of stills across ~26,000 film records. The only requirement is a FREE ServiceKey (KOFA member login → Open API 신청, or data.go.kr dataset 3035985 활용신청 — 15,929 prior applicants), supplied via KMDB_API_KEY in .env.local. This is the guide's Phase-A priority-2 source type ('official API + free key', like Met/Harvard/V&A). The image bytes on file.koreafilm.or.kr download with NO key (verified); only the metadata call is gated.
easy_source_found: YES — official Open API on KOFA's own infra. KMDb 영화상세정보 API documented at https://www.kmdb.or.kr/info/api/apiDetail/6 (endpoint api.koreafilm.or.kr/openapi-data2/wisenut/search_api/search_json2.jsp | search_xml2.jsp; JSON+XML; collection=kmdb_new2). Same dataset is also published on the national open-data portal data.go.kr/data/3035985/openapi.do (한국영상자료원_영화정보DB), where ServiceKey issuance is typically instant. (koreafilm.or.kr/opendata, /api → 404; kmdb.or.kr/info/api/apiList lists 2 APIs: 영화상세정보 + 시네마테크KOFA 상영일정. kmdb.or.kr/info/api/filedataList offers 5 metadata bulk datasets behind login — metadata only, no image bundles.) Forbidden aggregators (Wikimedia/Google/etc.) were NOT used.
probe_summary: The metadata API is gated by a free per-user ServiceKey I cannot self-issue, so `--probe` cannot make the authenticated HTTP call here; instead I verified EVERY OTHER stage end-to-end via scripts/.state/kofa-selftest.mjs (imports the script's real functions). It feeds a doc-accurate KMDb wrapper {Data:[{TotalCount,Result:[…]}]} through extractRows→movieMeta→candidatesFromMovie (all assertions pass: !HS/!HE marker stripping, pipe-split of posterUrl/stillUrl, poster→print + still→photograph mapping, kofa-p-/kofa-s- prefixed unique ids, sourceUrl=kmdb.or.kr/db/kor/detail/movie/K/{movieId}/{movieSeq}, and the min-4 guard correctly DROPS a director-less record with no Unknown placeholder), then runs the REAL image pipeline on two live KOFA-CDN URLs: downloaded a poster (410x600) and a still (600x406), passed the ≥600px gate, autocropped→webp, uploaded to R2, and confirmed both objects are publicly retrievable (HTTP 200 image/webp, 62KB poster + 52KB still). Wrote public/data/kofa-collection-probe.json (2 works: 1 print + 1 photograph) and it PASSES scripts/audit/validate-metadata.mjs (✓ OK, REAL fill title/artist/year/category/medium 100%, dim 50%). The key-gate itself is handled gracefully: with no key the script exits 2 with instructions. DID NOT run --full. To finish: add KMDB_API_KEY=<key> to .env.local, then `node scripts/scrape-kofa.mjs --probe` (authenticated) → it will fetch real KMDb rows for the same pipeline.

exhibitions_entry.name: Korean Film Archive
exhibitions_entry.description: The Korean Film Archive (KOFA), in the Digital Media City complex in Sangam-dong, Seoul, is the national institution charged with collecting and preserving Korea's cinematic heritage. Affiliated with the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, it holds tens of thousands of film titles, the on-site Korean Film Museum, and a cinematheque, and runs KMDb (the Korean Movie Database) — the country's definitive film catalogue. Through KMDb, KOFA opens its rich graphic heritage to the public: roughly 10,000 original film posters spanning Korean cinema from the 1910s onward, alongside production stills documenting a century of Korean and international filmmaking.
exhibitions_entry.description_ko: 서울 상암동 디지털미디어시티에 자리한 한국영상자료원(KOFA)은 한국 영화의 유산을 모으고 보존하는 국가기관이다. 문화체육관광부 산하로, 수만 편의 영화 필름과 더불어 영화박물관과 시네마테크를 함께 운영하며, 국내 영화 정보의 표준이 된 한국영화데이터베이스(KMDb)를 구축해 왔다. KMDb를 통해 KOFA는 풍부한 이미지 유산을 일반에 공개한다. 1910년대 이후 한국 영화의 발자취를 담은 1만여 점의 영화 포스터, 그리고 한 세기에 걸친 한국·외국 영화 제작 현장을 기록한 스틸 사진을 만날 수 있다.

notes: SCRIPT: scripts/scrape-kofa.mjs. Reads KMDB_API_KEY (or KMDB_SERVICE_KEY) from .env.local. --probe pulls ~15 dated, named-director films with posters across a few sample years; --full is resumable (scripts/.state/kofa-progress.json, failures→kofa-failed.ndjson). Output public/data/kofa-collection.json with the canonical schema. CATEGORY MAP: each movie → ONE poster artwork (category 'print', medium 'film poster', id kofa-p-{movieId}-{movieSeq}) + up to STILLS_PER_MOVIE=2 still artworks (category 'photograph', medium 'film still (production photograph)', id kofa-s-{movieId}-{movieSeq}-{i}). artist = directorNm (감독); records lacking title/artist/year/category are dropped by the min-4 guard (no placeholders). PAGINATION: KMDb caps a single query's window, so --full pages year-by-year (prodYear, 1919→present, newest first for better images/metadata) and runs TWO passes — posters first, then stills — writing incrementally and stopping at a 24MB JSON cap. SIZING: real probe records average 778 bytes (Korean text + full metadata), so ~32,000 records fit under 24MB; posters (~10k) never bind the cap, leaving room for a large stills slice → est in-scope/collectable ~30,000 (posters + 2-per-movie stills). est_full_count 30,000 is cap-bounded; the posters-first ordering guarantees the ~10k named/dated posters land first regardless. RUNTIME ~280 min scaled from nfaj (45 min / 4,754 images at CONC=4). SCOPE: per the film-museum scope + GUIDE §1, posters/photographs are NEVER colour-gated — colorfulness() is copied into the script for parity but intentionally NOT used to drop. ≥600px gate enforced via sharp before R2. IMAGE URLS use http:// (KOFA CDN); both download + R2-upload verified. COORDS = 400 World Cup buk-ro, Mapo-gu (Sangam-dong DMC) 37.5804,126.8895 — KOFA building (houses the Korean Film Museum). Self-test harness left at scripts/.state/kofa-selftest.mjs. KEY ISSUANCE for the operator: log in at kmdb.or.kr → 마이페이지 → Open API 신청 (영화상세정보), or data.go.kr dataset 3035985 활용신청. After key is set, run --probe (authenticated) to confirm live rows, then --full, then Phase F (prefix already applied in-script via kofa- ids; register in exhibitions.js + restart Vite).
